age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

blockers.description: Blocking codes: `pay_to_not_wallet`, and each applicable payer readiness blocker or reason prefixed `payer_`

readiness.description: Payment readiness of `payer` sending the amount to `pay_to`: what `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness` answers for the same payment, without its `meta`

amount.description: Amount checked; null when omitted (amount checks skipped)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

max_sendable.description: Most the source's balance allows it to send now, rounded down (freezes, limits and authorization are reported as reasons, not deducted); for an MPT issuer, the room left below the maximum amount; null when the source is the issuer of a trust-line token or when unknown

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

required_source_balance.description: Balance the source must hold for `amount`: XRP adds the larger of the reserve and the fee, a token sent between two holders adds the transfer fee (an MPT rounds up to whole base units); null without `amount` or when unknown

spendable_xrp.description: Source XRP above the larger of its live reserve and the standard fee; null when not computable

transfer_fee_pct.description: Issuer transfer fee in percent, when it applies

verdict.description: `not_ready` on any blocking reason; else `unknown` on any failed sub-check
`block` on any blocker, `warn` with warnings only, else `ok`

warnings.description: Non-blocking codes: `asset_not_canonical`, `payer_readiness_unknown`, and payer readiness warnings prefixed `payer_`

description: Can this payer settle this x402 payment requirement right now? When to use: After an x402 server answered 402 with an XRPL `exact` requirement: to check, before signing, that this payer can settle that exact requirement to that recipient now. Prefer another tool: For a payment that is not an x402 requirement (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`), or once the payment has settled (use `/v1/xrpl/payment/verify`). Example: xrpl_x402_preflight {"asset":"XRP","amount":"10000000","pay_to":"rhub8VRN55s94qWKDv6jmDy1pUykJzF3wq","payer":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"} Paid: 0.04356 USDC or 0.0363 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.03 EUR-denominated units (approx 33 calls per bundle) or 0.036 USD-denominated units (approx 22 calls per bundle).

amount.description: Amount the requirement asks for: a whole number of drops for XRP, a positive decimal in token units for an issued asset

asset.description: Asset of the x402 requirement: XRP, or the currency code of an issued asset (3 characters, case-sensitive, or 40 hexadecimal characters) whose issuer goes in issuer. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens.

destination_tag.description: Destination tag the requirement states (extra.destinationTag): an integer from 0 to 4294967295; it is passed to the readiness check

issuer.description: Issuer of the asset (extra.issuer of the requirement): a valid classic XRPL address; required unless the asset is XRP

pay_to.description: Account the requirement pays: valid classic XRPL address

payer.description: Wallet that would pay: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)
